limitations: Not wired in this worktree: no IPC channels, preload bridge or nav route (outside my owned paths). Captain/UI shell owner must wire per captain_wiring.

Connection checks verify reachability/key acceptance only. OpenAI chat, GitHub issue posting, weather widget, web research, calendar, news, downloads, sync and marketplace are not built; each is labelled with its blockers in the catalog.

No real provider, account or website was contacted during development; all network, DPAPI, filesystem and dialog behavior is tested with injected mocks. Real DPAPI round-trip for integration slots is untested here (same helper as the existing cloud key).
Last-check status and usage history are in memory (session only); enable preferences persist only if the captain supplies a PrefsStore.
Spotify desktop-app launch relies on the existing approved-apps + launch action; this module only documents it. spotify: URIs are not supported because open-url accepts http/https/mailto only.
Integrations.tsx reuses existing CSS classes; no new styles were added (styles are not in my paths).

This worktree's netGuard is the old version (no 'provider-check'); I could not see the security owner's new guard. Tests model the guard with a fake fetch, so an end-to-end check against the real new guard must run in the combined repository.
Tests depend on netGuard exporting the NetworkDenied class (the service imports it to label guard denials).
revision: 2026-10-14: per captain note, replaced the old-guard denial test with fake-guard tests: offline / missing key never reach fetch; with trusted confirmation online, anthropic/openai/issue-post/weather go to exact origin+path with GET, purpose provider-check, credential header only where a key is required; a modelled guard denial is reported as blocked and nothing is sent. Tests still use netGuard.NetworkDenied (the error class the service recognises), not its policy.
